title: A multidimensional Szemerédi theorem in integers
summary: For any integer $n \geq 2$, let $(m_{1},\ldots,m_{n})$ be a strictly increasing $n$-tuple of positive integers. We show that any subset $A\subset [N]^n$ of density at least $(\log N)^{-c}$ contains a nontrivial configuration of the form \begin{equation*} \boldsymbol{x},\boldsymbol{x}+r^{m_{1}}\boldsymbol{e_{1}},\ldots,\boldsymbol{x}+r^{m_{n}}\boldsymbol{e_{n}}, \end{equation*} where $c=c(n,m_{1},\ldots,m_{n} )$ is a positive constant.
